description:
Escape into 24 original corgi portraits in seasonal cottagecore settings illustrations designed for relaxed, unhurried coloring.

Each page is bold-outlined and printed single-sided on its own sheet — no color bleed-through, just room to create.

Structure the book as a 4-season journey (Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter) where each corgi is shown in bold, thick-outlined easy scenes doing a signature cottagecore activity per season—e.g., planting tulips in spring, picnicking in a wildflower meadow in summer, harvesting pumpkins in fall, and sipping cocoa by a fireplace in winter—paired with cottage-style props (mason jars, quilts, garden tools, baskets) to create a giftable, thematically bundled product that stands apart from generic single-season or plain 'dog portrait' coloring books.

Whether you're coloring to unwind after a long day or looking for a thoughtful gift, this collection offers a fresh page every time.
